answer: Hand each identity one ivory shard, a 50 GB slice, plus a $20 stake. Daily spot-checkers send proof requests at random hours over a 7-day horizon, with 10 minutes to answer. Missed proofs climb a penalty terrace at $10 times the square of the miss count: $10, $40, $90 for the first three. 100 clones on one rig store 5,000 GB; a sweep hitting 20 at once leaves 18 misses, or $21,090 in fines over $2,000 in stakes, versus $2,000 for 100 honest ones. A missed proof slashes the stake and zeroes the identity until it re-proves, like 100 storerooms behind one door when all must open at once.
